data.name: Millidor
data.detailed_description:
Миллидор – клиентская глобальная онлайн стратегия с элементами РПГ в лучших традициях классического фэнтези. Здесь вы можете стать правителем своего королевства - суровым, деспотичным воякой или дипломатичным торговцем – выбор за вами!. Ваш герой — аватар - является основателем новой империи, в его обязанности входит расширение ее границ, укрепление ее положения на мировой карте.
Мировая карта при этом вовсе не является постоянной и статичной. Возвышаются новые замки на недавно пустовавших землях, открываются новые месторождения ресурсов и беднеют разрабатываемые жилы, а на ваших собственных территориях появляются нейтральные отряды и армии соседских государств. Будьте готовы дать им отпор! В этом вам могут помочь ваши союзники — ведь какая война обойдется без дипломатии? В Миллидоре вы можете стать частью исторического альянса с богатым прошлым и ясным вектором развития, или, если будет на то ваше желание — основать свой союз, который будет идти по выбранному вами пути.
Высвободите жажду приключений, таящуюся внутри вас! Регистрируйтесь и начинайте играть в Миллидор!

Особенности игры:
- Выбор одной из шести рас - каждая обладает своими преимуществами и уникальными юнитами.
- Интерактивный игровой мир - локации меняются, появляются новые замки, ресурсы, отряды врагов. Сегодня свободные и пустынные земли завтра могут преподнести вам новые ресурсы или даже принадлежать новому хозяину.
- Тактика в бою и на карте мира - грамотное использование преимуществ ландшафта и глобальных заклинаний поможет доминировать в битвах.
- Масса PVP действий - тактические бои, осады замков и захват провинций. Вдумчивые пошаговые сражения, которыми можно управлять вручную.
- Система объединений - детальная политическая модель и универсальные социальные отношения с возможностью вступать в альянсы и достигать новых званий.
- Контроль территории - последовательное расширение владений и борьба за месторождения стратегических ресурсов с другими игроками.
- Сотни предметов - найм археологов для поиска редких артефактов, которые можно продать или использовать во благо своего королевства.
- Крафт и алхимия - удачные Алхимические опыты позволят улучшать найденные артефакты и получать мощные экономические и боевые преимущества.
- Шесть Божественных покровителей, лояльность которых - опора и поддержка во всех сферах игры.
- Прокачка навыков - участие в боях позволит повысить уровень Аватара и его характеристики. Каждый уровень дается выбор из нескольких боевых и экономических навыков, которые существенно влияют на успех в игре.
- Шесть школ магии: Воздух, Вода, Огонь, Земля, Жизнь, Смерть.
Заклинания в игре бывают самые разные: мгновенные и длительные, направленные на нанесение урона и на ослабление врага. Вы сможете изучать заклинания, создавать уникальные Свитки, а так же применять их как на Карте Мира, так и в бою.
- Развитие науки - изучение разных научных направлений поможет увеличить добычу ресурсов, откроет доступ к новым постройкам, увеличит скорость производства оружия, эффективность алхимии и археологии.

reviews.review:
Millidor is an ambitious free-to-play fantasy strategy game that attempts to combine kingdom management, tactical warfare, role-playing progression, and large-scale multiplayer competition into one interconnected experience. Developed and published by Smart Online Games, it places players in the position of aspiring rulers seeking to establish their influence across a persistent fantasy world. Its defining appeal lies in the freedom to pursue different approaches to leadership, whether through military conquest, diplomatic relationships, or economic development. Although its underlying concept is promising, the experience carries several limitations that prevent it from reaching the standards of more polished strategy titles.

The foundation of the gameplay revolves around constructing and expanding a kingdom while managing the resources necessary to sustain its development. Players can establish buildings, produce materials, recruit military forces, and interact with various locations across the world map. The castle serves as an important center of operations, connecting economic production with military preparation. This structure gives progression a recognizable sense of purpose, as decisions about infrastructure and resource allocation influence the kingdom's ability to expand. The management systems offer an interesting strategic framework, although players looking for immediate action may find the emphasis on preparation and gradual advancement less appealing.

One of the game's strongest conceptual features is the variety of strategic options available. Its Early Access description identifies six playable races, more than 110 units, hundreds of spells and artifacts, and over 70 skills. Such variety suggests considerable opportunities for experimentation with different army compositions, magical abilities, and character development paths. Turn-based combat provides the foundation for military encounters, encouraging players to consider positioning, available abilities, and the consequences of their decisions. The combination of fantasy units and magical systems has the potential to make battles more engaging than simple numerical confrontations. However, the quantity of available content does not automatically guarantee balanced encounters or consistently satisfying tactical depth.

Beyond warfare, Millidor incorporates several supplementary mechanics designed to make its world feel more substantial. Archaeology, alchemy, religion, scientific development, and quests contribute to the broader progression system. Religious activities involve altars and prayers, while alchemy introduces additional possibilities for experimentation. These interconnected mechanics distinguish the game from basic kingdom-building experiences by providing activities beyond resource accumulation and territorial conquest. Nevertheless, having numerous systems also creates a risk of overwhelming newcomers, particularly when their relationships are not communicated clearly. The effectiveness of these features ultimately depends on how naturally they complement the central strategic experience.

Multiplayer competition represents another essential component of the game's identity. Players can participate in alliances, compete for provincial capitals, capture strategic locations, and engage in arena battles. The struggle for territorial dominance gives the experience a broader objective beyond simply improving individual settlements. Alliances are particularly interesting because cooperation can potentially influence the balance of power between competing factions. The opportunity to become a diplomatic merchant rather than an aggressive conqueror also introduces welcome flexibility. Unfortunately, the appeal of these systems depends heavily on an active community, and a limited player population can substantially diminish the excitement of political negotiations, competitive warfare, and cooperative expansion.

The game's presentation follows a traditional fantasy strategy approach, prioritizing functional world management over elaborate cinematic storytelling. Its atmosphere is built around recognizable fantasy elements, including competing races, magical abilities, military campaigns, and territorial disputes. While this creates a suitable foundation for strategic gameplay, the overall concept does not demonstrate a particularly distinctive narrative identity. Much of its appeal comes from the possibility of creating personal stories through competition and kingdom development. Players who enjoy complex systems may appreciate this direction, but those seeking memorable characters, extensive dialogue, or a carefully structured campaign may find the experience comparatively limited.

Accessibility is one of Millidor's most significant weaknesses. The Steam listing supports Russian as its interface language without official English support, creating a considerable obstacle for international players. Understanding menus, unit descriptions, strategic instructions, and progression mechanics is essential in a game involving numerous interconnected systems. The additional requirement for a third-party account may also discourage players who prefer straightforward access through Steam. Although the free-to-play structure removes the initial purchase barrier, these practical limitations make the game less approachable than its price might suggest.

Another concern is its development status. Millidor remains listed under Early Access, and Steam warns that the developer's published development information has not been updated for an extended period. This raises questions about whether originally planned improvements, including expanded tactical systems, espionage, additional abilities, and enhanced combat features, will ever be fully implemented. The game's mixed Steam reception, with approximately 60 percent positive reviews, further suggests an experience that has struggled to satisfy its entire audience. These circumstances make long-term investment difficult to recommend without clearer evidence of ongoing support and community activity.

Regarding Steam Deck compatibility, Millidor does not have a confirmed official Steam Deck Verified or Playable designation. Its listed Windows support means compatibility through SteamOS and Proton remains uncertain. The interface may also be better suited to mouse-driven navigation than standard handheld controls, potentially requiring customized input configurations. Additionally, the third-party account requirement could complicate the initial setup. Steam Deck compatibility should therefore be classified as Unknown or Unverified, and players should not assume that the game will function properly on Valve's handheld.

Overall, Millidor presents an interesting combination of fantasy kingdom-building, turn-based combat, diplomacy, and multiplayer territorial competition. Its numerous units, magical systems, and progression mechanics provide an appealing foundation for players who enjoy traditional strategy games. However, language restrictions, uncertain development progress, and dependence on an active multiplayer community considerably weaken its accessibility and lasting appeal. Its ambitious design deserves recognition, but the execution remains difficult to recommend without reservations.

A conceptually engaging fantasy strategy experience with considerable mechanical variety, held back by accessibility problems, uncertain support, and limitations surrounding its multiplayer ecosystem.

Rating: 6/10
